label: S. 4555

latest_action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.

selection.reason: Impact scored and summarised by Gemini.

summary: The GAME Act of 2026 makes it illegal for certain large digital advertising platforms to display targeted sports gambling advertisements to minors. The law applies one year after enactment and is enforced by the Federal Trade Commission, with additional criminal penalties for repeat violations referred to the Attorney General.

affected_groups.effect: Individuals under 18 years old will be protected from receiving targeted sports gambling advertisements on large digital platforms.

Large social media platforms, search engines, and ad networks with over 100,000,000 unique monthly users must block targeted sports gambling ads directed to minors or face FTC enforcement and potential criminal fines.
Must enforce the prohibitions, has rulemaking authority, and must refer repeat violators to the Attorney General.

key_provisions: Prohibits covered digital advertising platforms from displaying targeted ads directed to minors that promote sports gambling platforms, starting one year after enactment.
Grants enforcement authority to the Federal Trade Commission by treating violations as unfair or deceptive acts or practices.
Requires the FTC to refer platforms to the Attorney General for criminal prosecution after 3 or more instances of violations or settlement actions.
Imposes criminal fines of up to $100,000 for each targeted sports gambling ad displayed to a minor after a referral instance.

Applies rules to platforms that derive advertising revenue, meet specific functional criteria (such as social media forums, search engines, or ad networks), and have more than 100,000,000 unique monthly users or visitors.
Defines a minor as anyone under 18 years of age, and defines sports gambling platforms to include services allowing gambling on sporting events or prediction markets.
missing_information: The exact legislative vote counts or prospects of passing.
Specific details on how platforms are expected to verify users' ages.

The law applies one year after enactment and is enforced by the Federal Trade Commission, with additional criminal penalties for repeat violations referred to the Attorney General.
summary_detail.significance: The bill creates federal restrictions on digital marketing of sports gambling to individuals under 18, applying penalties and enforcement mechanisms through the Federal Trade Commission and the Department of Justice for large-scale digital advertising platforms.
